title: Vegetable Lo Mein
description: Chewy egg noodles tossed with crisp-tender vegetables in a savory soy and oyster-style sauce. Better than takeout in 25 minutes.

image.alt: A bowl of lo mein noodles with cabbage, carrot, mushrooms and snow peas

steps.text: Cook the noodles as the package says, drain and rinse briefly with cold water so they don’t stick. Toss with a few drops of the sesame oil.
Whisk the soy sauce, hoisin, sugar and the rest of the sesame oil in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in the wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and ginger for {time 15 sec}, then add the carrots, pepper and mushrooms and stir-fry for {time 3 min}.
Add the cabbage and scallions and stir-fry until just wilted, {time 1-2 min}.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss with tongs until everything is coated and hot, {time 2 min}. Serve right away.

notes: Add cooked chicken, shrimp or crispy tofu for extra protein.
Spaghetti works in a pinch; cook it just past al dente.
